tools.name: feefo_list_reviews
tools.description: List reviews of your Feefo account, newest updates first. mode: all (service + product, default), service (seller/service reviews), product (product reviews; give product_sku or parent_product_sku) or nps (Net Promoter Score responses). Returns summary.meta (count, pages) and reviews[] with ratings,

tools.name: feefo_get_review
tools.description: Get one review by its id (the `id` of a service or product element from feefo_list_reviews), optionally with its full thread of replies.

tools.name: feefo_get_review_summary
tools.description: Aggregate ratings for your Feefo account: average rating and star distribution (1 to 5 stars) for service and product reviews, merchant details, review counts. mode: all (default), service, product (needs product_sku or parent_product_sku) or nps (promoters/passives/detractors). Use since_period=all

tools.name: feefo_get_product_ratings
tools.description: Average star rating per product SKU (products[] with rating, sku and optionally review_count). Filter by product_sku (comma-separated, leading/trailing * wildcards allowed) or parent_product_sku.

tools.name: feefo_reply_to_review
tools.description: WRITE: publish a public reply to a review on your Feefo account, optionally emailing the customer (notify_customer). findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: feefo_list_reviews, feefo_get_review, feefo_get_review_summary · Public sink: feefo_reply_to_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: feefo_list_reviews, feefo_get_review, feefo_get_review_summary · Public sink: feefo_reply_to_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
